reason: Check P3 enforcement remains additive, fail-closed, and secret-safe.
Check migration/schema parity and UTC safety if grant/audit storage changes.
Check denial/error shapes are sanitized, machine-readable, and do not leak internals.
Check logs/audit paths avoid secrets, payloads, commands, endpoints, and host-sensitive evidence.
Check frontend does not persist grant material or secret-bearing import state in long-lived storage.
Check frontend API/domain mapping is typed and avoids raw backend objects.
Check UI prompt follows existing component/dialog patterns.
Check grant prompt labels, focus, DialogTitle, and validation messages.
Check implementation stays within planned first P3 slice and keeps P4 out of scope.
Check acceptance criteria and scope for config import grant and batch-trigger telemetry.
Check implementation preserves P2 grant model and follow-up boundaries.
Check known gaps are addressed without adding unrelated surfaces.
Check implementation does not drift into SSH CA/Vault/recording/command-approval scope.
Check batch-trigger no-op telemetry is treated as audit completeness, not execution bypass.
